purpose: Show whether the development-frozen reference design changes model selection and clears the prespecified external 5% loss-reduction criterion.

panels.a: Model selection ranks for all six candidate designs at the primary total budget of 16 controls, using all 16 selection donors; one global family per design.
panels.b: Paired independent assessment losses for every eligible donor under the shared-selected and recommended-selected family, using identical deployment inputs and measured targets.
panels.c: Paired-donor t and studentized-bootstrap intervals for the prespecified practical margin, with zero marking the 5% benefit threshold. Both methods must clear zero.

uncertainty: Panel a describes the single fixed selection split, with no resampling-based inference. Panel b shows all individual donor losses without aggregate error bars. Panel c reports both prespecified two-sided 95% intervals, with donor as unit and 19999 bootstrap draws.
scope: Adapted fixed models, 1968 common genes and observed acquisition pools. Held-out measurement loss retains finite-cell noise and between-pool differences.
exclusions: No primary assessment donor or task is removed. Secondary budgets, deployment16, treated-state loss and overlap diagnostics remain in the accompanying numerical replay tables.
